boundaries_touched.review: Shadow execution (FORNX-386) adds isolated pre-flight verification for file-mutation and SQLite-migration domains, reusing Stage-5's fornax-experiment-runner isolation (StagedWorktree, GlobalExperimentPolicy, sweep_orphaned_staging_dirs) rather than a second experiment runtime. Every runner operates only against fully local, disposable resources (temp dirs, throwaway file-backed SQLite) -- no real network, credential, or production infrastructure is ever touched, by construction (is_local_only_target refuses every connection-string shape except :memory:/bare-path/file://). Infrastructure-plan/deployment-config domains were explicitly declined for this release since either would require real credentials/network reachability this release's own default-forbid policy disallows.
